The text contains a clear internal inconsistency. It begins by stating that Bob told his colleague he has been an only child all his life. However, it then describes a scenario a week later where Bob talks about his brother. The text itself acknowledges this contradiction by stating that the second statement "directly contradicts his earlier statement." Therefore, the narrative is logically inconsistent because a person cannot be both an only child and have a brother.

The season that comes after autumn is winter.
